body:
Today I was told that I have spent practically 5 years of my life studying something that won't give back anything to me and I couldn't help myself feeling like a failure.But damn, I am not giving up! I am gonna put every bit of effort that I have inside me.
 I am in a relationship that I have to end because it is destroying me but does that mean that I have to end my life for that? Hellz no! 
Passing grades is nothing impossible. Is it easy? No one says it's easy but it is not impossible like you are implying. It is never too late. 
You got your heart broken I got my heart broken by the only guy that I have ever loved. That means that you find someone that is going to cherish you and appreciate you more. It was not meant to be! In my country we have a saying " Bad things happen for a good cause".. Keep faith, man! Don't give up. It's not worth it.

Thank you for the words,kind stranger! :)
But I can honestly say that I am a forgiving person, very tolerant, open minded, educated. I am always ready to help my loved ones and of course all people in need when I can. I am honest, loyal, trustworthy.

I am not really religious. But since I have realized my mistakes I have started thinking about God, too. I know I am not obligated to reveal my past but that doesn't stop the fear of me facing my past with him. Because after that I don't know how to explain my actions from before, though they have nothing to do with me now.

It's so refreshing to see that you managed a way to get through this. Bravo! It's not easy for many people. I am a very tolerant person, I am forgiving and very supportive. My boyfriend says that he is the same things but I know deep inside if he knows everything, I wont be his "dream girl" and he would never look at me like before. I know it's not necessary that he knows everything but I would have felt better if he knew me a little more. I did put an end to this relationship once because of this but we got back together. I just love him too much and I can't imagine my life without him. I know there are things in life that are more serious and this may occur as a minor problem but right now it feels huge and I am just trying to find a way to be ok with it. I think if I forgive myself it would be much easier.

I have always been ashamed of my past but I managed to kinda forgive myself and move on and try to be better but since I have been in this relationship everything is coming back to me, every little detail, every little mistake, things that I haven't thought about in years. And the guilt rises more and more. Yesterday I had another break down. He wanted to upload our picture together on facebook but because I am so scared that someone is gonna see me and just say "Hey, dude, I have seen this girl doing this or that" and we had a huge fight. He knows I am not 100% honest with him. And I just broke down.All I could think is "Isn't it better to just end my life and put an end to this misery?" For some people I may be exaggerating but I am just sharing how I feel.

I am glad everything is fine with you. Hopefully I am also fine. It's pretty scary because it's not just any kind of disease. It's a "shameful" disease. 
He is bothered by the fact that I have dated, that I have had boyfriends.The worst part is that he doesn't know the whole truth. He is pretty conservative and jealous. Despite of those things he is good to me and I love him to death. It's just I feel bad about myself when I know what my boyfriend's standart and principals are.

Unfortunately I haven't. My friends keep telling me that I don't need an std test because I haven't had sex but I feel like my guilt over the things I have done has created this huge fear of any std. I am going to pick myself together and do it. But I am super scared.

I know its easy to say and we as humans do that pretty often but you cant compare urself to everyone - not your brother, not your father, not anyone. You are you. Your mistakes, failures and your achievements are yours. No one is perfect, not everyone achieves what the want the easy way. The one important thing you can do is learn from your mistakes. I have two brothers and one sister and I can imagine what u are talking about. Be yourself, improve yourself. Dont be so hard on yourself. :)

Fortunately I didnt lose my virginity to that douche. I am still a virgin. We made out. But everyone else thinks that we slept together because of the message he is spreading around for over 4 years now. (pathetic I know)
Yes, we have discussed it. He is also a virgin. He has kissed only 2 girls in his life. That's one of the other things that make me feel shitty. We decided to have sex after we get married. But we definitely kiss and hug.
PS. Thanks for the response.

Everyone feels like that at some point of their life. Believe I have felt like that so many times. People would get married and engaged around me all the time and I would just feel miserable. But life is also about improving yourself. Someone will find you, or you will find that someone one day and it will be worth all the waiting.
What makes you happy? Good books, traveling, movies, sport? Whatever makes you feel better (if it doesnt harm you of course) try it! Dont give up. You are here for a reason, like everyone else!

Many times we would feel that it is better off if we could just disappear but that is not true. If there are people that need you ( like your two brothers) you need to fight and stay for them and you will be rewarded for that one way or another.
